_comment: Checks flatpak-builder-lint reports that Varda knowingly accepts, passed with
flatpak-builder-lint enforces Flathub's SUBMISSION POLICY, not Flatpak correctness.
Varda self-distributes a .flatpak bundle and is not submitted to Flathub, so a
policy check it cannot satisfy is not a defect. Everything else the linter reports
is still fatal, which is the point of listing exceptions here rather than ignoring
finish-args-host-filesystem-access: --filesystem=host. Flathub grants this one on
explanation; the explanation is in the manifest next to the permission. A VJ's media
and show workspace live at arbitrary paths chosen mid-show, so a portal file chooser
Nothing else belongs here. In particular manifest-json-warnings must stay fatal: it
is how flatpak-builder reports that it could not load cargo-sources.json.
